caseStudy.metaDescription: A quote app for tradespeople, designed, tested and deployed end to end: integer arithmetic, VAT per rate, permissions, CI and free hosting.
caseStudy.title: GestionDevis
caseStudy.lead: A quote app for tradespeople, <accent>designed, tested and deployed</accent> end to end.
caseStudy.dashboardAlt: Dashboard: signed amount, pending amount, acceptance rate and quotes breakdown

need.label: 01 — The need
need.title: A wrong quote is lost margin.
need.body: Many tradespeople still price jobs in spreadsheets: VAT at several rates computed by hand, numbers kept in memory, no tracking of what was sent or accepted.

answer.label: 02 — The answer
answer.title: Correct maths, clear tracking.
items: Net total, VAT by rate and gross total recalculated as you type
Tracking draft → sent → accepted or declined
Quote as a PDF, ready to send

form.alt: Entering a two-line quote, totals shown live
form.caption: Each line has its own VAT rate; totals follow your typing.

detail.alt: Quote detail with VAT broken down by rate and PDF buttons
detail.caption: VAT broken down by rate, preview or download in one click.

internals.label: 04 — Under the hood
internals.title: The choices that make the difference.

cards.title: No decimal numbers
cards.body: Prices in cents, quantities in hundredths, VAT in basis points. Every calculation uses integers: no rounding drift.

cards.title: VAT computed per rate
cards.body: VAT is computed once per rate on the cumulated net base, like on a real invoice, rather than line by line.

cards.title: Everyone gets their own data
cards.body: A Symfony Voter checks the owner on every access: a user can never see or edit another user's clients or quotes.

cards.title: A demo that stays clean
cards.body: One-click sign-in, and demo data reset on every start, with a safeguard that refuses to touch a database containing real accounts.

stats.label: style, analysis and tests on every push

closing.title: The easiest way is to try it.
closing.body: Next steps under consideration: quote → invoice conversion, e-mail sending, REST API.
